purpose: Runs an app in headless Chrome for an end-to-end proof: starts Chrome with a throwaway profile, drives the page over the DevTools Protocol, takes screenshots, collects console errors, and runs named legs that print PASS or FAIL.
namedChanges: Added assertButtonRows, collectButtonRows, judgeButtonRows and classifyButton: the button-row check (RuleUiActionRowMacOrder) on a live page, at a size you choose.
startBrowser takes headed and keepProfile (a profile that survives between runs); page.waitForHuman prints a message and waits for a person; buildChromeArgs is exported.
Added makeTools(page) and byTestId: exists, wait, gone, click, clickText, set, waitImage, setFiles, noHorizontalScroll, taken from the run-9 e2e-lib.mjs.

library.title: Browser proof (headless Chrome end-to-end harness)
library.note: Node test helper, no packages, no React: startBrowser launches headless Chrome with a throwaway profile in a folder you name and gives a page (goto, eval, waitFor, screenshot, consoleErrors, key, setViewport); runLegs runs named legs, prints PASS or FAIL for each, fails a leg that logged a page error, and exits non-zero on any FAIL. Chrome and its helpers are stopped and the profile removed, even on failure. Also found as: browser test; end-to-end test; headless Chrome; e2e harness; take screenshots in a test. Button row check (assertButtonRows: right-aligned, positive rightmost, Cancel left of it, Delete alone at the far left) at desktop and phone width; headed runs with a kept profile and waitForHuman for a sign-in code; makeTools page helpers (click, set, clickText, setFiles, waitImage). Also found as: button row check; end to end; e2e; headless; headed; browser test; sign-in code.
